decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the west facing and east facing walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - All footings/excavations within the  correct protection zones proposed by BS5837 (table 1) be dug by hand. If during the excavation, any roots greater than 25mm diameter are found they must be either 'boxed in' with shuttering ply (allowing at least 75mm clearance all round for expansion growth) or the root be bridged by a lintel. This technique should avoid concrete coming into direct contact with the root and allow for further growth. Under no circumstances should any roots be severed without the correct application for work on TPO'd trees being agreed upon in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The premises shall be used for a snooker room and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to public house and amended parking layout.
